loop.order: dependency-driven: scripts/harness/sprint10_driver.py starts one task per controller state
loop.sequencing_note: Each task carries depends_on; sprint10_driver.py start refuses until every dependency is verified and while WIP is 3 (charter D6). T0 first; T1, T2, T5 (Lane B head), T10, T14 and T15 become startable after T0, subject to WIP <= 3. T3 after T1; T4 after T3. Lane B serial T5 -> T9. Lane D: T15 -> T12, T14 -> T13 -> T16. T11 after T1, T2, T4, T5-T9 and its requires_done rows exactly Done. T17 last. Day-1 WIP ruling (Adam, 2026-09-29): WIP stays 3 as written. After T0, open T1, T2 and T5; T10 waits for the first free slot (it has the whole sprint), and so do T14/T15. Soak ruling (Adam, 2026-09-30): a task whose work is recorded (controller status verifying) and whose only remaining evidence is a time window holds no WIP slot while `sprint10_driver.py soak` marks it; only tasks declaring soak_window_hours (T1 24, T2 72) may soak, a marked task never counts, and it re-enters only via a locked `resume` when a slot is free (new starts wait behind it), so WIP never exceeds 3. S17/S18 (T18/T19, lane E) added mid-sprint the same day.
loop.max_iterations_reason: Charter D6: 3 attempts per task, 12 iterations per goal. 'Goal' is read as one SI: the driver initializes each task in its own controller state capped at 12 iterations. A happy-path task costs 3 iterations (execute record, verify run, manual-evidence record) and a failed attempt at most 3, so 3 attempts fit inside 12. The pinned controller keeps one global counter per state, so the cap is enforced per SI rather than claimed.

close.requires: every task verified, or explicitly waived by Adam with a reason. Sprint 10 pre-authorises no drops: waiving any task requires a charter update.
close.definition_of_done: Every Sprint 10 acceptance row is Done with AC-by-AC evidence, or the SI is dropped by a written charter update. The close hard gate's no-To-Do result is necessary but not sufficient; T17's evidence check enforces final Done statuses.
close.handoff: python3 scripts/harness/sprint10_hard_gate.py --json, plus the controller's evidence log
